title: Embed Hunch as system-wide hook layer across all development harnesses
context: User maintains engineering memory (findings, decisions, constraints) via hunch. Previous approach required manual recording. Need unified observation across Claude, Codex, Cursor, VS Code, Windsurf, Antigravity, Copilot.
decision: Configure hunch 1.43.0 as automatic hook interceptor: PreInvocation/PreToolUse/Stop hooks on all file operations, MCP server registration, consistent configuration across harnesses. Expands PreToolUse matcher to catch Bash/PowerShell, not just file writes.
consequences: File operations now trigger hunch hooks automatically — findings/decisions can be recorded in-flight
Hunch knowledge graph becomes source of truth for institutional memory across sessions
All harnesses use same hunch version and hook behavior — unified observation
15ms hook latency added per file operation (timeout: 15s)
alternatives_rejected: Keep manual post-hoc recording: requires discipline, misses context, no automation
Per-harness hunch config: fragmented, version drift, inconsistent behavior
Hunch as passive tool (no hooks): loses capture window, knowledge must be solicited
